name: Buitch

attributes.attribute: also called Fir as Mraane Obbee, man of enchantment
also called Fir as Fysseree, man of knowledge
the craft was generally considered harmful

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Buitch is a Manx witch. One title for her is Fir as Mraane Obbee, or man of enchantment. Another is Fir as Fysseree, or man of knowledge. The generic Manx word for witch likely derives from the English word. The term buitcheragh probably comes from witchcraft. The craft was generally seen as harmful on the Isle of Man. Still, some practitioners could use their skills for good.

okr.objective: Describe Buitch, the Manx witch figure.
key_results: Her titles meant man of enchantment and man of knowledge.
The word likely derives from the English term witch.
Her craft was usually seen as harmful.
